what: Operation counts of the unified model (fastcalc.engine), observed from outside with reporting stand-ins for the inputs and wrappers around the shared functions. No count is a tally kept by the engine.
data_statement: SYNTHETIC_FICTIONAL data only. Counts of this code on these inputs; not evidence about real buildings or about any other tool.

how_to_read.phases: aggregate = the pass over the input rows; finish = everything that depends on the study period; second_period_finish = finish again for another period from the same aggregation (totals-only mode)
how_to_read.multiplications: products in which the named kind of value is an operand. while_reading_a_material_or_equipment_row excludes the builder of composite factors, which is reported as in_recipe_builder (it runs once per distinct composition)
how_to_read.year_loops: nominal number of yearly values handled by the functions that loop over the study years, by class: value_loop (a total is accumulated year by year), series_generation (yearly values are generated from a descriptor), copy_check (descriptor values compared with the table copy), validity_scan (a year table that is the input is checked), yearly_output (series of the full outputs)
how_to_read.second_period: 30 years (twice that when the scenario's own period is 30)

P1.statement: totals-only mode: no multiplication by a factor-record value (or gas amount) is executed while a material or equipment row is being read; the only such products of the whole aggregation are those of the builder of composite factors (once per distinct composition, see P5)

P2.statement: totals-only mode: the material list and the equipment list are each iterated exactly once, every row is handed out once, nothing is read by index, and finish reads no row and no row list

P3.statement: totals-only mode: no list of the years of periodic material or equipment renewals (and none for the rebuild) is built; the lists that are built are those of explicit event lists and of refrigerant charge changes, whose counts are given

P4.statement: parametric yearly inputs, totals-only mode: no loop that computes a value per year (class value_loop) runs; what remains is the consistency scan (descriptor values generated and compared with the table copy), whose size is given

P5.statement: composite factors: one computation per distinct composition, in both output modes

P6.statement: a second study period from the same aggregation reads no material row and no equipment row (the counts for the refrigerant rows are given as well)

P7.statement: the record part of a factor (exists, licence, stage, value and gas amounts valid) is checked once per (factor, stage); the scenario's conversion table is consulted once per unit pair; a resolution without row-specific conversions happens once per (factor, stage, unit). Work that is repeated per row is limited to the resolutions of rows that carry their own conversions and to the applicability check of a product-specific factor (both counted in the evidence), plus reads of the memos

notes: The counters that remain in the engine's _stats (factor_records_resolved, unit_pairs_resolved, recipes_computed) are compared with the observed counts under engine_counters.

Pseudo-key lines: the charge x GWP of a refrigerant device (tag device_gwp) and the construction electricity x grid value (tag grid_construction_value) are multiplied once per device / once per scenario in the aggregation; they are reported under multiplications and are not factor-record values.
Row attribute reads are counted on the row object itself; reads of objects a row refers to (its transport or end-of-life record, its lists) are not counted separately.
